title: 跨欄選字後，動作列更容易找到
summary: 滑鼠跨欄或反向拖選文字後，動作列會靠近放開滑鼠的位置，避免被頁面遠處的選取範圍帶到螢幕邊緣。
highlights: 優先使用滑鼠放開位置附近的文字範圍，異常或過遠的座標會改用放開位置。
快捷鍵叫出的動作列仍依選取文字定位，並保留螢幕邊緣避讓。
usage: 更新後啟動 SnapBar，在已啟用自動顯示動作列的情況下拖選文字即可，不需新增設定。

en.title: Find the toolbar near cross-column selections
en.summary: After a cross-column or reverse mouse selection, the toolbar stays near the release point instead of following distant selection geometry to the screen edge.
highlights: Uses text bounds near the mouse release point, falling back to that point when bounds are invalid or too distant.
Keyboard-triggered toolbars still follow selected text and stay within the screen work area.
en.usage: After updating, start SnapBar and select text with automatic toolbar display enabled. No new settings are required.
